title: Tkibuli miners’ underground refusal over January wages
reason: The reviewed report describes miners refusing to leave their workplace underground over reduced January pay; it does not establish a public assembly, an own-state demand, or a qualifying crowd size.
notes: The wage claim is directed to employer Saknakhshiri. The company’s commission is not state accommodation.
